Honey Garlic Chicken Wings
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, December 14, 2009 - 12:00am

Ingredients




1/2 cup liquid honey
1/4 cup lemon juice
1/4 cup water
3 tablespoons ketchup
1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder
1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
1 teaspoon ground ginger

Preparation

1 Combine all ingredients in sauce pan. Heat to boiling and simmer for 5 minutes. 2 Place 3 lbs chicken wings separated into a 9x13 baking dish. Pour sauce over wings. Marinate for 2 hrs. 3 Bake at 400 F for 1 hour, turning once. 4 Submitted by: Shannon
